description: Na₃Zn₂(WO₄)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.54 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.69 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.92 Å. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. All W-O bond lengths are 1.90 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.84 Å. Zn is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.29 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one W and one Zn atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one W, and one Zn atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one W atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one W, and one Zn atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one W, and one Zn atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one W, and one Zn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂ZnW tetrahedra.
